Key interpretation limit
ⓘ
Recorded stop counts are not passenger demand.

The file does not define the period or method for “Num trips in stop.” Low counts cannot establish that a location is underserved.

This is a descriptive student analysis, not an official BMTC assessment or feasibility study.

Method & sources

Definitions and limits are part of the analysis.

Annual operations

Numeric values plotted as supplied. Period changes use (later − earlier) ÷ earlier × 100. Missing values and text-formatted cells remain unavailable.

Division fleet

Six named divisions compared by financial year. Source Total shown separately. The simple division mean weights every division equally.

Stop records

Numeric counts classified as zero, below 50, above 1,000, or missing. No period definition is present in the downloaded CSV.

What would make a service-gap assessment stronger?

Obtain a defined count period, route-level scheduled and operated trips, time-of-day service, passenger boardings or an accepted demand measure, and a field check. Then test whether low service coincides with unmet demand before recommending a change.
